description: This file is a React functional component that implements a form modal for selecting and making certain agents public within a web application. It manages user interactions, state, and API calls related to the visibility and public status of agents in the system.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Resets form state and closes the modal.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next step after validating selected agents.

methods.name: handleAgentSelection
methods.description: Updates selected agents set based on individual selection checkboxes.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all agents based on the 'Select All' checkbox.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Finalizes the process, calls API to make selected agents public, and handles success/error notifications.

methods.name: renderStep1Content
methods.description: Renders the UI for selecting agents.

methods.name: renderStepContent
methods.description: Chooses which step content to render based on current step.

methods.name: renderStepButtons
methods.description: Renders navigation buttons for the multi-step form.
